enunciado: With sorted arrays a[i] = 2i of size 10, 100 and 1000, count the worst-case comparisons (searching an absent value larger than all) for linear and binary search.
objetivos: Compare O(n) with O(log n) with real data
pistas: Linear search checks all n elements.
Binary search makes about log2(n) + 1 comparisons.
Multiplying n by 10 adds only about 3 or 4 comparisons to binary search.
